reviews.comment: Literally the best mouse ive ever had! Silent and fits well in my hand. The buttons are light and it glides really nicely!
reviews.author: johnson

reviews.title: Super cute, comfortable to hold and easy to use <3
reviews.comment:
The mouse is so adorable, comfortable to use, and easy to connect the Bluetooth. My USB port is rusted and I can't get any USB connector to get in it, but I wanted a mouse that I could use both Bluetooth and USB in case I get a different laptop in the future and want to use the USB connector, or in case a friend or family member wants to use it with the USB connector.
I chose to get a mouse for my laptop because I just got back into gaming and certain games work better with a mouse. After testing the mouse I am pleased with how it works. I do not experience any lagging with the mouse (I know this can be an issue with Bluetooth-connected mouses (mice?)). I am able to see how much battery the mouse has on my Lenovo laptop, it fits perfectly in my hand and is extremely comfortable to hold. I especially love how the sides are not smooth like the top of the mouse, it makes it easier to grip.
I was a little worried about buying such a "cute mouse" as sometimes you sacrifice functionality for looks but so far this is not the case :)
reviews.author: Faithy

reviews.title: Good quality
reviews.comment: Looks exactly as shown. The pink color is so pretty. The mouse clicking is super quiet and muted. The scroll wheel is very smooth as well, the increments aren't felt as much. Easy to set up with the instructions and software to customize the thumb buttons. Have been using it for a few months, so far, so good!
reviews.author: Blarb

reviews.title: Logitech Bluetooth Mouse Signature M650
reviews.comment: Package arrived in good condition. Tested out the mouse Bluetooth wise first and it worked/works well, no glitchiness, stuttering, works as Bluetooth should. Tested out the usb connection later and it worked after a bit of finagling to make it not connect Bluetooth wise but that was a me problem not a product problem, it worked/works as expected as well. Battery is staying good so far, haven't had it even a month though so I'll have to see if it lasts as long as it says it will but it's doing well so far. The grip is good and the mouse weighs very little, practically nothing really. I was concerned about the side buttons, that they might get pressed accidentally while using the mouse but I have had absolutely no issue with that, hasn't been a problem and the fact you can choose to change what the buttons function as is brilliant, I changed mine to volume buttons because my keyboard ones don't work and its been the best thing ever, can't believe I didn't know this was a thing, could have saved me so much annoyance, lol. The program used to program the mouse is simple and easy to use and setting it up was no issue as it just basically came up when the mouse connected and was ready to use quickly. I was a bit concerned that the price wouldn't be worth it but turns out it was money well spent, definitely no regrets so far. Most expensive mouse I've bought in my life I believe but well worth it with all the functions and improvements that a mouse comes with now.
reviews.author: pjthepanda

reviews.title: Great mouse
reviews.comment: I got this for my wife when her old mouse went down.  She is very happy with this mouse and its many features.  The 2 main things that she is happy with is the quiet clicks.  No more click...click...click, and the precision scrolling.  It just makes scrolling a heck of a lot easier!  I like the fact that when I was setting it up on her laptop that I did not have to use the supplied dongle to set it up.  All I had to do was use the Bluetooth, let the laptop and mouse connect to each other, and you are set to go.  No more dongle sitting out of your USB Drive, leaving that USB Drive available for another external hard drive or anything else that requires a USB drive.  I am very happy with this purchase of the Logitech Signature M650 Wireless Mouse - For Small to Medium Sized Hands!
